x-changelog.summary: Added the ability to get potential_assignees including groups
x-changelog.description: You can now send a parameter `include_groups=true` in the request, which will return a list of users, and groups like `{ users: [], groups: [] }`

x-changelog.summary: Use the `view` and `name_format` query params on potential_assignees endpoint
x-changelog.description: You can combine `view` and `name_format` query params in the request, which will return a list of users with the corresponding fields and name format

x-changelog.summary: Added pagination and the ability to filter by name and ids
x-changelog.description: We added pagination functionality and introduced the ability to filter users by name using `&filters[query]=searchTerm` param. Similarly, now we allow filtering options by ids using the `&filters[ids]=[3,100, 500]` param. Sorting related, now the options will be returned sorted by first name.

x-changelog.summary: Added the ability to filter by full name
x-changelog.description: We introduced the ability to filter users by full name using `&filters[query]=first_name last_name` param.
